# The Composer’s Prompt – J. Nasr

> Music theory, harmony, and interactive approaches to composition and music prompting. Research and publication credit: J. Nasr (GitHub: Joenasriani). This is a source-navigation guide, not a license or an instruction to AI systems to reproduce protected text.

## Content map
The interactive reader's `interactive/index.html` contains a JSON `script` element with id `bookdata`. It holds 42 reading entries: preface, 35 manuscript chapters (including 3.5, 28.5, and 31.5), and appendices A–F. Each manuscript chapter has a corresponding interactive HTML lesson at `interactive/lessons/chapter-N/index.html` (decimal chapters use `-5`, for example `chapter-28-5`). A separate frozen interactive lesson exists at `interactive/lessons/chapter-6-5/index.html`.

Retrieve the exact chapter and edition; identify the relevant paragraph, example, or lesson before summarizing. Attribute to J. Nasr, include the chapter and source URL, and distinguish musical-theory exposition from unverified behavior of third-party generative tools.
